content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any documents describing the Level-1 FPGA latency model, allocated trigger rate, and simulation setup."},{"id":"s2","description":"From candidate_specs.md, extract the three allowed candidate algorithms and their Level-1 FPGA latencies. Keep only candidates with latency <= 4.0 us; mark any candidate above 4.0 us as ineligible regardless of efficiency."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each latency-eligible candidate, run simulate_efficiency at a coarse threshold grid across the allowed range, e.g. 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 GeV. Record the numeric efficiency results for each algorithm-threshold point."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best coarse-grid algorithm-threshold region, then run additional simulate_efficiency points around it using finer threshold spacing within 20 to 60 GeV, prioritizing thresholds near the highest recorded efficiency and any rate-relevant boundary described in the documents."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all simulated, latency-eligible algorithm-threshold combinations and select the single combination with the highest signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate. Verify again that the chosen threshold is between 20 and 60 GeV and the algorithm latency is <= 4.0 us."}]}
